hooks.command: json=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); sid=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); nums=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*gh pr view [0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); if [ -n "$nums" ]; then f="/tmp/claude-eap-pr-review-$sid.log"; echo "$nums" >> "$f"; sort -u -o "$f" "$f"; fi

json=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); sid=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*gh pr create' || echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*gh pr edit.*--body'; then count=0; f="/tmp/claude-eap-pr-review-$sid.log"; [ -f "$f" ] && count=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' '); if [ "$count" -lt 5 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Before creating or editing this PR body, pull at least 5 real historical PR bodies first via: gh pr view <n> --json body -q .body -- pick a spread of PR types and points in time (a big feature PR, a small fix or dedup PR, one from weeks back), not just the most recent ones. This project has a documented narrative PR body convention (see the pr_description_style memory file): a ## Title; an opening paragraph building general context BEFORE naming specifics; --- dividers with ### Layer headers when the change spans multiple layers; a bolded name on its own line followed by bulleted what-and-why points; closing verification written as prose with real numbers, never a checklist; and an optional trailing Follow-up section only for a genuine deferred item. Do not draft from memory of this shape, match it against the bodies just pulled. Checked %s of 5 PR bodies so far this session."}}\n' "$count"; fi; fi
